entities.summary: Keyvius Nathaniel Sampson is an American professional baseball pitcher who is a free agent. He has previously played in Major League Baseball (MLB) for the Cincinnati Reds, in the KBO League for the Hanwha Eagles, and in the Chinese Professional Baseball League (CPBL) for the Uni-President Lions and Fubon Guardians.
